question: Can the fixed original EM closure function be proved to have exactly one simple positive root without relying on the numerical derivative scan?
summary_de: Für die festgelegte ursprüngliche EM-Gleichung ist die positive Nullstelle jetzt analytisch eindeutig und einfach nachgewiesen: F bleibt bis 2c^3 negativ; danach ist F wegen der exakt bewiesenen Log-Konvexität der Nahtantwort streng konvex und wächst gegen unendlich. Das ursprüngliche Intervallprogramm lokalisiert diese einzige Nullstelle. Die Wahl von M=41, Exponent−5/4, Nfac=8 und damit c=1/(8π), Nahtantwort und physischer α-Identifikation bleibt vorausgesetzt.
summary_en: The fixed original EM equation has exactly one simple positive root by an analytic argument: F is negative up to 2c^3, then strictly convex by exact log-convexity of the seam response and diverges to infinity. The original interval implementation locates that unique root. Selection of M=41, exponent−5/4, Nfac=8 and hence c=1/(8π), the seam response and physical alpha identification remains assumed.
scope: All positive alpha for the exact default v3 EM function; mathematical existence, uniqueness and simplicity under fixed inputs, not their physical selection.
assumptions: The original make_F default formula with c=1/(8pi), p=1/(6pi), d=48c^4, exponent−5/4 and M=41.
Positive real alpha, original real logarithm branch and q in(0,1).
Physical interpretation of the root and selection of the input function are separate obligations.
positive_results: Exact log-convexity of the prescribed phi=p+q(1−q)^−5/4.
F<0 on(0,2c^3] and F strictly convex afterward with limit+infinity prove one simple root on the entire positive half-line.
Original F_iv gives a strict sign bracket [0.0072973525622097,0.0072973525622100] for that unique root.
The same argument holds for every M>0; the unique root increases strictly with M. Mathematical uniqueness does not select budget41.
kills: Need for a numerical first derivative zero or finite sign scan to establish uniqueness of this specified function.
Inference that one indeterminate interval cell alone proves uniqueness.
leaves_open: Derive the chosen response functional, Nfac=8 / c=1/(8pi) normalization, M41 budget, exponent5/4 and injection48c3^4 from the common physical source.
Derive the identification of this mathematical root with the measured fine-structure constant and the physical observable/state dictionary.
novelty_scope: A complete elementary analytic argument for the existing project-specific root lemma, not a new selection of the EM equation or a full derivation of alpha.
